output_text:
import os
import requests

def select_platform_resource(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("Missing OpenRouter API key. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY or pass config['api_key'].")

    model = config.get("model") or payload.get("model") or "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
    site_url = config.get("site_url") or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_SITE_URL", "https://example.com")
    app_name = config.get("app_name") or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_APP_NAME", "managed-model-platform-workflow")

    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "HTTP-Referer": site_url,
        "X-Title": app_name,
    }

    models_resp = requests.get("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models", headers=headers, timeout=30)
    models_resp.raise_for_status()
    models_data = models_resp.json().get("data", [])

    selected = None
    for item in models_data:
        if item.get("id") == model:
            selected = item
            break

    if not selected:
        family = model.split("/", 1)[0] if "/" in model else model
        for item in models_data:
            item_id = item.get("id", "")
            if item_id.startswith(family + "/"):
                selected = item
                model = item_id
                break

    if not selected:
        raise ValueError(f"OpenRouter model/resource not found: {model}")

    messages = payload.get("messages")
    if not messages:
        user_input = payload.get("input") or payload.get("prompt") or ""
        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": str(user_input)}]

    chat_body = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
    }

    optional_fields = (
        "temperature",
        "max_tokens",
        "top_p",
        "presence_penalty",
        "frequency_penalty",
        "response_format",
        "tools",
        "tool_choice",
    )
    for key in optional_fields:
        if key in payload:
            chat_body[key] = payload[key]
        elif key in config:
            chat_body[key] = config[key]

    response = requests.post(
        "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions",
        headers=headers,
        json=chat_body,
        timeout=60,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    completion = response.json()
    choice = (completion.get("choices") or [{}])[0]
    message = choice.get("message") or {}

    result = {
        "provider": "openrouter",
        "resource_type": "model",
        "resource_id": model,
        "resource": selected,
        "output": message.get("content"),
        "raw_response": completion,
    }
    return result
